name: DARBF-Splatting
aliases: Decaying Anisotropic Radial Basis Functions Splatting
definition: A splatting method that generalizes reconstruction kernels beyond the exponential family by using Decaying Anisotropic Radial Basis Functions (DARBFs). DARBFs are non-negative functions of the Mahalanobis distance that support anisotropic behavior and differentiability, enabling differentiable rendering while approximating the Gaussian function's closed-form integration advantage.
